# pantechdynamics_database_engines (Data Source)

Lists the database engines and the long-term-support version lines offered for new pantechdynamics_database resources, with the zones each version can be created in. A version appears only while it is offered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Engines and the version lines offered for new databases, with their zones.
data "pantechdynamics_database_engines" "all" {}

output "postgresql_versions" {
  value = [
    for v in one([for e in data.pantechdynamics_database_engines.all.engines : e if e.engine == "postgresql"]).versions : v.version
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `engines` (Attributes List) The engines. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--engines))
- `id` (String) Always "database_engines".

<a id="nestedatt--engines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `engines`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Name for display, for example "PostgreSQL".
- `engine` (String) The value the database's engine argument takes, for example "postgresql".
- `port` (Number) TCP port the engine listens on.
- `storage` (Attributes List) Data disk sizes a new database of this engine may have, one entry per zone where it can be created and storage is offered. They bound storage_gb on pantechdynamics_database. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--engines--storage))
- `versions` (Attributes List) Version lines offered. Empty when the engine has none on offer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--engines--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--engines--storage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `engines.storage`

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String) "NGN" or "USD". Null when not priced.
- `max_gb` (Number) Largest data disk in GB.
- `min_gb` (Number) Minimum data disk in GB. 0 means the plan's disk_gb is the minimum; otherwise the minimum is the larger of the plan's disk_gb and this value.
- `min_is_plan_disk` (Boolean) True when min_gb is 0, so the chosen plan's disk_gb is the minimum.
- `price_per_gb_month_minor` (Number) Price of one GB of data disk for a 730-hour month, in minor units of currency (kobo or cents). Null when the zone could not be priced.
- `step_gb` (Number) Above the minimum, storage_gb must be a multiple of this.
- `zone_id` (String) The zone, for example "af-abj-2".


<a id="nestedatt--engines--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `engines.versions`

Read-Only:

- `eol_date` (String) End-of-life date of the line (YYYY-MM-DD), or null when not announced.
- `version` (String) The value the database's version argument takes, for example "18".
- `zones` (List of String) Zones this version can be created in.
